identifier.value: Mobile Freight Logistics Platform is similar to Packlink

overview_description.description: Keychain Logistics is a software marketplace that directly connects companies shipping products with independent semi-truck owner-operators. The platform effectively cuts out the traditional third-party logistics brokerage process by virtue of a software enabled network of virtual carriers (trucks on the go in our network). They understand where trucks in their network are at any given moment, their capacity, and if they would be an ideal match for a company shipping.
